footnote: Source: CADPA, January to June reports 2025 and 2026. Shares of overseas revenue of China-developed mobile games
notes: Where the money comes from. The US has not changed in ten years. It sits around a third, 32.31% this half. The same figure appears for 2022 and full-year 2025 too, that is how the reports print it. What changed is Japan: 23.91% in 2020, 16.20% a year ago, 14.05% now. Germany, the UK and France together went from 8.78% to 10.14%. The association does not publish the three separately. Note the base: overseas revenue of China-developed mobile games, so PC and console are not in it. The Middle East and Latin America get talked about a lot, but there is no published share to chart, so they are not here.
